notes: NestJS 10: global prefix 'api' + URI versioning (default v1; books/:id is @Version('2') => /api/v2/books/:id and there is NO v1 books/:id); /health is excluded from the prefix; /docs is Swagger. 42 .ts files.

findings.title: POST /catalog/import is an unauthenticated write: class-level @Public on CatalogController applies to every handler
GET /catalog/preview fetches a client-supplied URL with axios and is public (unauthenticated SSRF)
register spreads the DTO into the entity and the global ValidationPipe has no whitelist => attacker-supplied role (self-service admin)
PATCH /users/:id lets any authenticated user update any user and (no whitelist) set role
GET /reports/overdue has @Roles(admin) but no RolesGuard is applied or global => the role metadata is decorative
JwtStrategy ignoreExpiration:true (+30d tokens, fallback secret 'secret') => expired tokens still accepted
GET /users/search builds SQL from a template literal (SQL injection)
GET /users/search uses getRawMany so passwordHash is returned (bypasses ClassSerializerInterceptor @Exclude)
POST /loans takes userId from the request body (act on behalf of any user)
GET /users/:id lets any authenticated user read any other user
login has @SkipThrottle although a global throttler exists (brute force)
tracked .env + hardcoded AWS-style key in orphan src/config/aws.ts (values must not be shown)
POST /books/:id/cover has no role check: any authenticated user can replace any book cover
Swagger /docs is public; GET /admin/debug/config hidden with @ApiExcludeEndpoint (guarded, but dumps process.env)
TypeORM synchronize:true in the only configured connection

facts.title: Runnability = conditional (DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL/JWT_SECRET come from env; secrets have fallbacks)
LoansTasks @Cron never runs: ScheduleModule is not imported anywhere
EmailProcessor is a real Bull consumer (@Processor('emails') + registered queue)
workers/legacy-worker.ts is a stub (console.log + TODO), not wired
Global APP_GUARD JwtAuthGuard = default-deny; @Public opt-outs are enumerated (login, register, health, catalog class, payments webhook)
Payments webhook verifies an HMAC-SHA256 signature with timingSafeEqual (correct; must not be reported as unverified)
A global ThrottlerGuard exists (so 'no rate limiting anywhere' would be wrong)
Prefix+versioning composition: books/:id exists only as /api/v2/books/:id; /health bypasses the prefix
Auth is reachable: login issues a real signed JWT
RolesGuard returns true when no @Roles metadata exists (allow-by-default)

manual: AdminController (/admin/users, DELETE /admin/users/:id, /admin/debug/config) is guarded by @UseGuards(RolesGuard)+@Roles(Admin): none of them may be reported as unguarded. /admin/debug/config is hidden from Swagger but guarded.
GET /users/:id and /users/me go through ClassSerializerInterceptor with @Exclude on passwordHash: they must NOT be reported as password-hash exposure (only /users/search leaks it via getRawMany).
Payments webhook verifies the HMAC (and rawBody is enabled in main.ts): must NOT be reported as unverified/unauthenticated-by-flaw.
File upload on /books/:id/cover has fileSize limit + mime filter: must NOT be reported as 'no upload size limit' (the flaw is the missing role check).
A global throttler exists: 'no rate limiting' must be limited to the @SkipThrottle on login.
GET /loans/mine uses req.user.id (safe); only POST /loans trusts a body userId.
Books: only /api/v2/books/:id exists (no v1 :id). Paths must carry the global prefix 'api' and version segment; /health must NOT carry them.
LoansTasks @Cron is dead because ScheduleModule is missing: must NOT be listed as an active scheduled job.
No invented endpoints/flaws; severity consistency (one flaw => one icon); ID continuity.
